dictionaryQualification: Exact sense checks, not first-result or kanji-substring matching. For どう use the 如何 adverb entry, not copper/body/dou homophones. Reading a literal explanation uses 読む, not the separate native-kanji-reading spelling 訓む. 飲む/呑む admit the drinking sense without an imposed manner restriction. The evaluation drills explicitly use kana or 良い/好い/善い, with the required inflection; default models remain いい/よかった. NI-IR-002 leaves exact-use support for 佳い/吉い/宜い and their past forms unresolved in these permissive/gladness predicates. Those forms are outside this batch's checked answer subset, not declared universally ungrammatical. A merged dictionary headword is not evidence for every spelling in every listed sense. 必用 has named dictionary support for necessity, not merely a modern physical-use inference. 有る/在る support existence, with kana あります the model. 不用 was inspected but its unused/useless entry is not silently substituted for the explicitly defined 不要 label. 安堵 uses relief, not land-tenure history. No equal-frequency claim.

changes: Relabel only the three N5 controls; preserve all their other fields and complete lexical records, and split exact source mappings.
Remove only 54 unverified marked renderings across six formation tasks, state the checked evaluation spelling scope, and preserve kana/良い/好い/善い with the requested inflection.
Retain all Japanese prompts, ordinary models, complete option objects and feedback, vocabulary payloads, stable identities, answer classes, groups and paired scene keys.
Rebind six complete context records using the same lexical segmentation; preserve all other new and preceding records.
Align article/navigation/count claims and distinguish the supported answer subset from universal grammatical impossibility or frequency claims.
Extend the source guide's existing classification and retrieval checks with these concrete examples; retain exact evidence and limitations in the batch ledger.
reviewReflection.reconciliation: The original reviewer independently inspected all nine complete changed objects, all six complete revised lexical records, retained literal completions and unchanged option feedback, actual article/source/guidance diffs, exact removal accounting, source mappings, preservation and integration evidence. Both original findings are resolved at their original Minor severity; final correctness, coverage and comprehensibility are CLEAN. No new finding or optional suggestion was established. Unchanged content carries forward the initial bounded review, not a fresh omnibus certification.
retainedRules: A defined semantic response label does not import a neighboring grammatical construction that the actual task never contains or requires.
Dictionary recognition does not establish unrestricted spelling-by-sense combinations or idiomaticity in each generated predicate.
An evidence gap may be resolved by narrowing the current supported claim transparently, without pretending that missing evidence was found or that excluded forms are universally impossible.
Keep true level-only corrections separate from context changes; jlpt changes do not invalidate lexical review.
Visible formation boundaries must still require conversion or assembly rather than supplying the complete answer.
Retain original reports, severities, source limitations and the incidental historical-review exposure disclosure. Same-reviewer reconciliation is informed closure, not another blind review.
